NNEW CONCEPT ENGLISHBOOK 01 / 新概念英语

BOOK ONE · LESSON 068

What's the time?

几点钟？

A bilingual lesson built around 12 numbered clocks and 10 dated place illustrations (church, school, the office, the butcher's, the hairdresser's, the baker's, the dairy, home, the grocer's, the greengrocer's) that practise the 'Where were you on ...?' and 'When were you at ...?' structures. Includes workbook day-of-week ordering, was/wasn't fill-ins, at-the prepositions, and open-ended personal answers, plus grammar on where-/when-questions with was/were. 以12幅编号时钟和10幅带日期的地点插图为主的双语课，练习「……你在什么地方？」和「你什么时候在……？」句型。配合教材星期排序、was/wasn't 填空、at the 介词练习和自答练习，以及 where/when 问句和 was/were 的语法练习。

Written exercise A Complete these sentences using the where necessary.

No official key is supplied; answers are constructed from standard English usage (the + place names that take the definite article) and labelled suggested. Blank for 'the' is filled with 'the', blank with no article is filled with '—'.

A The days of the week

These are the days of the week. Write them in the correct order. 按照正确的顺序写出一周中的 7 天。

Write the seven days of the week in the correct order, starting on Monday.

The printed word bank is: Wednesday Friday Monday Tuesday Saturday Thursday Sunday. The printed example shows 'Sunday' circled as one of the days. The key lists the seven days in order starting on Monday.

B Structure

Fill in was, wasn't or were in these sentences. 用 was, wasn't 或 were 填空。

Fill in the correct form (was, wasn't or were) in each blank.

The workbook key does not cover this exercise in a directly usable form; the answers are constructed from standard English usage and the sentence context and labelled suggested.

C At or at the

What do we say in English – at or at the? Write in at or at the. 用 at 或 at the 填空。

Fill in each blank with 'at' or 'at the'.

The key lists 12 items (1 at the, 2 at, 3 at the, 4 at the, 5 at, 6 at the, 7 at the, 8 at the, 9 at the, 10 at the, 11 at, 12 at the). The printed exercise shows 11 blanks (items 2-12 in the key's numbering); item 1 of the key is not part of the printed exercise and is not editable here.

D About you
